lastTask: Implement Byte UI-2 high-level control bar and written-to-evolving dial

projectState.summary: Byte UI-2 is implemented on codex/byte-ui2-control-dial and ready for Claude review. The top bar now includes a real Line slider: written below 0.34 disables prosody and stops evolving, speaking from 0.34 to 0.67 enables existing prosody only, and evolving at 0.68+ starts the existing D5 evolving performance with deterministic per-song branch/seed options. Sliding down stops evolving and clears the audition override through the existing teardown path. The change is UI/orchestration only; no transport, scoring, candidate, or persistence internals changed. Validation: build green, smoke 70/70, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
